slides.title: What do you carry out this door?

body.text: This is fighting to get an underhook.

items: Whoever connects first wins by locking his hands around his partner's body, armpits to ankles.

body.text: This is getting close while he blocks you.

items: The top player wins by getting under the bottom player's elbow and locking his own hands around him.
The bottom player wins by closing his legs around the top player's waist.

body.text: Back Take – Maintain Chest to Back Contact
This is holding his back from behind.

items: The attacker holds as long as he keeps contact.
The defender wins by getting his back to the mat or turning face to face.

slides.title: What made it work?
slides.question: You and your partner are locked in an over-under tie on the very last roll. What's the smart move?

options.text: Fight to close your hands under his elbows.
options.feedback: Closing the connection clean, on the last roll, is exactly what you carry out the door with you.

options.text: Let go and grab a totally different hold.
options.feedback: Letting go here gives away the tie you already have.

options.text: Hold still and wait for him to move.
options.feedback: Keep fighting to close your hands instead of waiting.
